instruction: Can you upscale this photo to 8K resolution (7680x4320) while reducing the file size to under 10KB?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because upscaling an image to 8K resolution (7680x4320) while simultaneously reducing file size from ~50KB to under 10KB is physically impossible. Higher resolution requires more data to store pixel information, contradicting the file size reduction requirement.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible due to contradictory requirements (upscale to 8K while reducing file size to under 10KB)
